exposure: presence of pronounced abdominal and pelvic adhesions
outcome: frequency of intra- and postoperative complications
cohort: A study of 265 women undergoing surgery for reproductive system diseases, where 91 had pronounced abdominal and pelvic adhesions and 174 did not.
finding: Laparoscopic access for surgical treatment of women with reproductive system diseases and pronounced abdominal/pelvic adhesions is possible and safe, showing no statistically significant differences in surgical outcomes (duration, blood loss, pain, hospitalization, convalescence) or complication rates compared to those without adhesions.
